note: The ordinary deploy, and the reason the tool is usable at all. A digest is content-addressed, so the previous digest identifies the exact bytes to roll back to -- this is the one image reference static analysis can prove is immutable. Contrast K8S008: any tag, semver included, is a mutable pointer the registry operator can move, so it stays COSTLY. Nothing but the image changes here, so K8S012 must not fire alongside.
